commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
Her friend worries that she can’t bear it. She answers, to say that she can.

I am bearing up, but this pallor, proud that he gave birth to it, has mounted my body and drives it on. It rides by right, so you needn’t worry.
